title: 36 Hours in Melbourne, Australia
abstract: Often overlooked by travelers as they sprint their way through Australia’s Big Three tourist attractions, visitors should take some time to appreciate this laid-back city.

title: 36 Hours in Hollywood
abstract: Hollywood is one of those rare places that live up to their stereotypes, right down to the sign. But with minimal effort, it can offer a whole lot more.

title: 36 Hours in Breckenridge, Colo.
abstract: This former mining town, unlike its upscale Colorado neighbors, Vail and Aspen, still exudes a crunchy, laid-back vibe.

title: 36 Hours in Cape Town
abstract: No other African city combines heart-stopping beauty and historical gravitas so effortlessly.
